papers.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
papers.abstract: A real-time interactive video generation model supporting voice control of digital characters. Users can control video generation content at any moment through voice instructions. Vidu S1 supports infinite-length real-time video generation without blurring, drift, or visual distortion.

papers.title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
papers.abstract: A diagnostic suite for systematically auditing existing video understanding benchmarks. Audit reveals that 55% of existing benchmark samples are solvable without visual input or temporal context. After filtering these shortcuts, remaining video-native challenges expose substantial capability gaps.

papers.title: Why Can't I Open My Drawer? Mitigating Object-Driven Shortcuts in Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition
papers.abstract: Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition requires recognizing novel verb-object combinations composed of previously observed primitives. This work tackles a key failure mode: models predict verbs via object-driven shortcuts rather than temporal evidence. Proposes RCORE with co-occurrence prior regularization and temporal order regularization.

papers.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: A capability-driven benchmark for evaluating proactive agents in dynamic, real-world settings. Comprises 400 bilingual real-world tasks across five foundational capabilities: Skill Usage, Exploration, Long-Context Reasoning, Multimodal Understanding, and Cross-Platform Coordination.

papers.title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Recovering high-quality video from sparse event streams using pre-trained video diffusion priors to jointly handle event-based video reconstruction, prediction, and frame interpolation. Introduces Autoregressive Unrolling and Adaptive Context Switching to mitigate temporal drift in extremely long sequences.

papers.title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
papers.abstract: Canvas360 framework for in-context panoramic generation combining geometry-aware pretraining with downstream task-specific fine-tuning. Proposes Canvas360Dataset with 1M high-quality paired panoramic samples.

papers.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
papers.abstract: A generative model designing small molecules conditioned on both disease ontology and target protein sequences. Developed by fine-tuning GPT-2 using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning via group relative policy optimization.

papers.title: CineMobile: On-Device Image-to-Video Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Enables efficient image-to-video generation on mobile devices through distillation-guided pruning, diffusion distillation, and hybrid quantization techniques. Achieves 40x speedup compared to teacher model while maintaining visual quality.

papers.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
papers.abstract: Comparative study of softmax attention and four recent recurrent linear-attention architectures: DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, and Gated DeltaNet-2.

papers.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Studies memory as active intervention mechanism rather than passive retrieval for long-horizon tasks. Separate memory agent runs alongside action agent, updating structured memory bank and deciding whether to inject memory-grounded reminder.

cc_updates.body: Added directory path suggestions to `/cd`, matching `/add-dir` behavior. Added a `/doctor` check that proposes trimming checked-in `CLAUDE.md` files. `/commit-push-pr` now auto-allows `git push` to the repo's configured push remote. Gateway: `/login` now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints. `EnterWorktree` now asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project's `.claude/worktrees/` directory. Background agents now upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update.

Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files. Fixed `--json-schema` silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid. Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the `--max-turns` limit. Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it. Fixed background agents staying shown as failed or completed in the agent list after being resumed with SendMessage.
Fixed hook events not streaming during SessionStart hooks in headless sessions, which could cause remote workers to be idle-reaped mid-hook.
